# --- Main Crawlers ---
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Allow: /images/
Allow: /videos/
Allow: /blog/
Allow: /custom-*
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /cgi-bin/
Disallow: /private/
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /tmp/
Disallow: /*.pdf$
Disallow: /?s=
Disallow: /*?s=

# Attribution-only duplicates of the homepage.
# Every Get a Quote button links to /?from=<that page>#contact so the
# enquiry form knows which page produced the lead. They are the homepage
# and they say so with a canonical, but Google was still crawling 160 of
# them - on a site with 161 real pages that is half the crawl budget spent
# re-reading the homepage. Measured in Search Console 10 Nov 2026 as 89
# URLs under Alternative page with proper canonical tag.
# The parameter must keep working for humans; only crawling stops.
Disallow: /?from=
Disallow: /*?from=
